name: Nam pia
summary: A Thái offal dish. Bảo tàng tỉnh Sơn La sets it from cow or goat blood, with tail, stomach, and the base of the heart, plus the thick liquid from the small intestine, called pịa. Cook it until the pot tightens. Eat it hot with banana flower and mint, and with rượu.
origin: Bảo tàng tỉnh Sơn La, the 21 March 2020 handbook. A second method was not re-read.
howToEat: Hot, from the pot, with banana flower and mint, and with rượu. The handbook calls it an acquired taste. A shop that posts it every day is Check on arrival.
where: The Thái table in this province. The handbook does not pin a street. A price is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Nam pia in Son La — Thai offal from the handbook
seoDescription: Nậm pịa in Sơn La, set from cow or goat blood and the thick liquid of the small intestine. Eat it hot with banana flower and mint. A price is Check on arrival.
